title: Shipping and delayed orders
content: Standard delivery usually takes 3-5 business days after dispatch. Carrier delays can extend this estimate. Customers can share an order number to check the sample order records.

title: Returns
content: Eligible unused items can be returned within 30 days of delivery. The customer should provide the order number and item name so support can explain the next steps.

title: Damaged products
content: For an item that arrived damaged, ask the customer for the order number and a description of the damage. A support agent must review the case; the assistant cannot approve replacements or refunds.

title: Refunds
content: After an approved refund is processed, it usually appears on the original payment method within 5-10 business days. The assistant cannot issue or verify a real refund.
